packing: bits, little-endian within each byte, 1 = land, row 0 south, x fastest
distPacking: uint8 per cell, distance to shore in 20 m units (255 = 5.1 km or more), row 0 south, x fastest
source: NOAA ENC depth areas (the chart layer's chart.json; drying areas and uncharted land between charted water count as land) worked out at 50 m, and the GSHHS full-resolution coastline where there's no US chart; 200 m cells, water where a quarter or more of the cell is (pipeline/routegrid.py)
